args.subject: Group Booking Availability — 10 Guests, June 2024
args.body:
Dear City Hub Tokyo Group Bookings Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am organising a group stay at City Hub Tokyo and would like to enquire about availability for a party of 10 guests in June 2024.

Could you please let me know:
- Whether you have availability for 10 guests in June 2024
- The available dates and any group rates or packages on offer
- Whether there are minimum-stay requirements or deadlines for securing a group booking
- Any information on group amenities, such as breakfast, meeting space, or luggage storage

I would be happy to provide further details on our preferred dates and requirements once I have received your availability.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
